{"id":"71224165-930a-4768-9bf4-52fc19cce34c","body":"October 29 — local partial H2 account-authority journal foundation delivered; full connected authority remains pending.

Readiness remains pushed as [9164e16](https://github.com/kokin-blip/Coqui-Crypto/commit/9164e163af667c82d66cd3b7cd15146a046e4a96). New foundation is LOCAL/UNCOMMITTED: strict account authority read contract, separate explicitly created/opened format1 SQLite journal (no profile migration/default path), immutable scope/event/command history, exact retry/conflict handling, preparation-session CAS/fencing, expiry refusal/quarantine, unverified P2 checkpoint references and consistent backup. No active/enrolled/available state, funded financial claim or dispatch permit exists in this version. No Main/IPC/renderer/connected factory is wired.

Exact isolated seven-path closure over pushed readiness passes 351 suites / 2,379 tests, including 16 new authority cases, root build, typecheck and lint. Working root/renderer typecheck, focused lint and 4 suites/29 cases pass. Separate actual Node processes verify one winner at a shared head, durable lost-ack retry and no authority from independent copies. This proves one-store preparation serialization only, not cross-host account control. No new UI/native/release result is claimed.

Source/evidence: `docs/implementation/small-portfolio-p6-h-authority-delivery-2026-10-29.md` and `docs/implementation/evidence/p6-h-authority-foundation-2026-10-29/validation.json`. Preservation verifies 3,350/3,354 baseline file bytes unchanged; only three index exports and the tracker changed intentionally. Unrelated work, working generated manifests, original plans, frozen reports/negative findings/consumed identities remain preserved; new candidate manifests are separate source evidence.

H1 intended-host/topology/credential/dedicated-account/source/current-provider/financial/rights review remains pending (host question presented, no answer inferred). H2 actual verified financial/shared claims/budget/enrollment, H3 dispatch/all-consumer enforcement, H4 real settlement/fee/manual/restore/takeover proof and H5/H6 integration/permitted observations are unfinished. P5-H, actual G admission and actual P7-H–J remain open in full. No provider/installed DB, order/cancel/withdrawal, pause/Resume, registration/collector/final/qualification or deployment/release action. COQ-40 stays In Progress; dependencies and milestone criteria unchanged.

**Prompt used**

Commit and push the P6-H readiness work, then continue building the account-wide authority using the saved plan. Preserve unrelated work and the full P0–P7 scope, keep unmet evidence gates pending, and update the phase tracker.
